sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Balbir Yadav Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Brij Kumar Saroj,Kharag Singh Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
Heard Sri Kharak Singh, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

Smt. Sheeva Khan, has lodged the successive F.I.Rs as a Case Crime No. 730 of 2023, P.S.- Kwarsi,
District- Aligarh.

By means of the present petition, the petitioners are assailing the legality and validity of the impugned F.I.R. dated 25.07.2023 lodged as Case Crime No. 730 of 2023, u/S 498A, 354, 323, 504,
Aftab Husain And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129742098/
1 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage), Act, 2019, P.S.- Kwarsi, District- Aligarh.
On the earlier occasions, she has already filed an F.I.R. as Case Crime No. 945 of 2020 at P.S.-
Kwarsi, District- Aligarh, which ended into a compromise and this Court has quashed the earlier proceedings and at page 48, there is an order passed in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.15901of 2020 for quashing the entire proceedings of the earlier F.I.Rs.

entities.text: Aftab Husain And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Now, this is the successive petition.

This is a grossest ever misuse of the Criminal Proceedings u/S 498A, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C.
It is made clear that the investigation shall go on unabated and the petitioners are required to participate in the investigation but they shall not be arrested till submission of report u/S 173 (2)
Cr.P.C.,whichever is earlier.
With the observations, the writ petition stand disposed of.
